analysis_frame.scope: The independently printed A at the start of p170 B1 row3 group2 restores the short p158 XDGV group to AXDGV. Three other coordinate disagreements remain untouched in the raw frame.

record.readable_german: ANENMELDUNG. Serb. Kavallerie Peterwadein und Fehertemplom eingerueckt. Abmarsch 217 I D und ? R D nach Norden ohne Feinberuehrung.
record.meaning: The report describes Serbian cavalry entering the places transmitted as Peterwadein and Fehertemplom, followed by a northward departure of 217 I D and ? R D. The final phrase appears to mean without enemy contact, but its literal FEINBERUEHRUNG lacks the D of FEIND; that letter is not inserted in the cipher frame. ANENMELDUNG remains unexpanded.
notes: The235 current-source coordinates remain in order. One observed A from the independent p170 witness is added; it is not claimed to be visible on p158.

All236 single-coordinate alignments against the p170 source are enumerated without a language target. Four equivalent boundaries82–85 minimize disagreements at3; they yield the same filled236-coordinate stream but different source maps. Boundary85 respects the visible four-coordinate XDGV group.

The three source disagreements independently support KAVALLERIT→KAVALLERIE, PETERWADE2N→PETERWADEIN and NOYDEN→NORDEN. The shared EINGSRUECKT→EINGERUECKT and FEINBELUEHRUNG→FEINBERUEHRUNG proposals remain editorial.
The exact spellings PETERWADEIN and FEINBERUEHRUNG remain without prose insertions in the readable layer. The already reviewed parallel case discusses Peterwa[r]dein and Fein[d]beruehrung separately.
The source advertises two parts but only part1 is included in this edition. The next page begins a separately headed telegram; adjacency does not identify it as the absent part2.

optional_prior_headline_candidate.scope: The earlier p170 source edition proposes ABENMELDUNG. Applying it here costs two further observed-coordinate substitutions. The missing D of ABEND remains a prose-only insertion, not a recovered coordinate.

parallel_reference.claim: The new physical witness repeats the earlier source-edited report with a one-coordinate deficit and three coordinate disagreements. The same station pair and1915 time are printed, but reception dates differ by one day. A specific copy/reception mechanism is not inferred.

prior_credit: The operational body, p166/p167/p170 relationships and earlier word proposals are credited to the existing p170_continuation source edition by icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. Published period key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). The present contribution is p158 E1 source review and the complete source-to-source insertion audit. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: The source-derived gap comparison is exhaustive only within a one-coordinate insertion family, with the published key fixed.
Repeated report text and matching time/station fields do not prove a particular historical copying or reception mechanism.
One unresolved reserve-division label remains globally bound to cell VF, with alternatives5/6; no new historical identification or square completion is asserted.
The exact readable stream retains ANENMELDUNG, PETERWADEIN and FEINBERUEHRUNG. Fully normalized words would require additional explicitly marked prose letters.
